title: Rank-one invertibility of the normalized affine Hom comparison
statement: Let Y be a scheme, U an affine open, A=Gamma(Y,U), T the associated-sheaf functor transported along isoSpec, and c the comparison uniquely normalized on global generators [lem-sc-k4-affine-hom-generator-extension]. For every A-module N, c(A,N):T(Hom_A(A,N))->internalHom(T(A),T(N)) is an isomorphism. No finiteness assumption on N is required.

source.place: Lemma-spec-sheaves (4)-(5), Hom functoriality and rank-one evaluation.

proof.text: Evaluation at one identifies Hom_A(A,N) with N via ModuleCat.homLinearEquiv and LinearMap.ringLmapEquivSelf. Identify T(A) with the structure sheaf using tildeSelf and restrictUnitIso, and apply SheafOfModules.homObjUnitIso to identify internalHom(T(A),T(N)) with T(N). Precompose the comparison followed by this identification with the generator h. Normalization, functoriality of internal-Hom sections, and evaluation at one identify the result with the image of h(1). A-linear maps out of A are determined by their value at one, so h is the element map for h(1). Generator detection therefore equates the comparison followed by evaluation with T of the module evaluation isomorphism. Both evaluation maps are isomorphisms, hence so is the comparison. The same proof includes the zero ring and zero coefficient module.

based_on.place: Lemma-spec-sheaves (4)-(5), Hom functoriality and rank-one evaluation.

theorem affineHomComparison_chart_rankone {Y : Scheme.{u}} (U : Y.affineOpens) :
    ∀ N : ModuleCat.{u} Γ(Y, U.1),
      IsIso (affineHomComparison U (ModuleCat.of Γ(Y, U.1) Γ(Y, U.1)) N)
